name: filter.range
title: Field: filter.range
description: Meaning of the buyer query filter.range field.
text:
# filter.range

TL;DR:
- filter.range is a geo radius in kilometers.

What it means:
- filter.range limits results to listings within the given maximum distance from meta.latLon.
- Without meta.latLon, range has no meaningful geo anchor.

Agent hint:
- Use filter.range together with meta.latLon. The returned listing.distance is also in kilometers.
